Import help text — 9 Nov 2026

Import → Assign, the help text under "Trigger automation and process management" ends: "Owner assignment from the chosen rule runs regardless". Import has no rule to choose, so the sentence points to something that isn't there.

Please reword it to say what actually happens: rows with no owner are assigned to the person importing.

Zoho Desk (checked live 9 Nov) has no rule or owner option and no text about a rule on any import step.

Evidence: NDC-2275-import-help-text.png (attached)
